source.quote: TRASAM's own page for the DAC4PLUS « 解码器 », read 2026-11-27 with curl. Core features: « ESS9028PRO 双核DAC芯片 »; « USB / 光纤 / 同轴三路输入 »; « RCA + 3.5mm耳机双路输出 »; « 支持DSD64/128 ». Details: « 采用 ESS9028PRO 双核DAC芯片，信噪比115dB以上，支持 DSD64/128 高清格式。 »

facts.chip: ESS ES9028PRO, described as « 双核 » (dual-core); the page does not say whether that means one part or two.

_thin_and_why_it_is_still_written: The page states a converter part, a DSD ceiling and three inputs - and no PCM rate, no word length and no per-input figure. That is thin, but unlike the xDuoo pages set aside as too thin it does carry behaviour: DSD128 is a ceiling a consumer can act on. pcm_max_hz is absent.
